@vijaymehtanz Okay worked it out:

Fixed on main: Hermes Cloud runs Telegram through a shared Hermes...
items.content:
@vijaymehtanz Okay worked it out:

Fixed on main: Hermes Cloud runs Telegram through a shared Hermes bot, so a bot of your own gets switched off at every start (that's why QR setup never worked, and why the workaround kept the machine awake). Link your Telegram account from your agent's Message platforms in Nous Portal and message the shared bot; no workaround needed, and the instance can sleep. The instance's Channels page now points you there too once you're on the new release.
items.author: @Teknium
items.summary: Teknium details a resolved Telegram issue: Hermes Cloud runs Telegram through a shared Hermes bot which disabled users' own bots at every start, breaking QR setup. The fix on main lets users link their Telegram account from Message platforms in Nous Portal and message the shared bot, removing the keep-awake workaround, with the Channels page updated to point users there on the new release.
items.reasoning: Detailed root-cause explanation and merged fix on main from the lead, directly actionable for Telegram users of Hermes Cloud; low engagement but high practical value.

items.content_html:
@vijaymehtanz Okay worked it out:

Fixed on main: Hermes Cloud runs Telegram through a shared Hermes bot, so a bot of your own gets switched off at every start (that's why QR setup never worked, and why the workaround kept the machine awake). Link your Telegram account from your agent's Message platforms in Nous Portal and message the shared bot; no workaround needed, and the instance can sleep. The instance's Channels page now points you there too once you're on the new release.
